name: Buckaroo for Drupal
description: Integrates the Buckaroo payment provider (via the buckaroo/sdk) to take online payments; ships a Webform payment handler submodule.
project_description:
With this module customers are able to perform payments to the site owner through Buckaroo . Currently this module only has Webforms as a payment context and only has iDEAL as a payment method.

 You will need a Buckaroo account to use this module.

 Included submodules 
 
 Buckaroo for Webforms 
 
 Roadmap 
 
 Support for all available payment methods 
 Commerce support 
 
 Similar projects 
 This module is the Drupal 8 successor of Buckaroo Payment . This module takes inspiration from the Mollie for Drupal module.

 This module is support by VDMI and maintained by Mitchell Steenwijk ,
